emotional_tone: Rooted, trustworthy, direct-to-consumer farm fresh transparency with modern Swiggy/Zomato-quality speed and ease

surface_strategies.headers: Crystal Glass with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/60 z-50

key_functionalities: Location picker modal mandatory on first load with quick preset cities
Marketplace browse with instant category filter, search, sorting, and map toggle view
Product detail view with farmer story, soil health index, harvest timestamp, and fast add-to-cart
Buyer requests & live order tracking with status updates
Farmer Dashboard with products, inventory sync, live incoming orders, bulk requests, and crop insights
Ask Uzhavan conversational AI assistant panel with structured action confirmation cards
Byproducts marketplace & Admin audit logs & user management

accessibility_and_testing.interactive_elements_must_have: data-testid attributes on all buttons, links, inputs, and tabs
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: WCAG AA compliant contrast with tinted greys and clear focus states

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a responsive, polished, Zomato/Swiggy-grade React frontend for Uzhavan 360. Use the external API URL from frontend .env or a fallback proxy/mock when API is unreachable. Ensure all pages (Marketplace, Product Detail, Requests, Farmer Dashboard, Admin, Ask Uzhavan AI, Auth) are fully interactive, beautiful, and robust with data-testid attributes.
